scope: One local, finite, paired multi-step chain-source comparison. No environment expansion, new query fitting, new loss or architecture.
frozen: DINO, preprocessing, object encoder, scene encoder, decoder, selected corrected query perseed, query normalization, threshold, controller
single_step_schedule: Exact prior new-coverage transition schedule:48common oldAB+12new normal+4new held_closed draws, identical in both arms. No change to samples/order/budget.

multi_step.sampling: Every multi-step batch contains each paired root and each of its two3-skill windows twice; identical paired order across arms, shuffled by fixed seed. No discontinuous or reset edges.
multi_step.only_treatment: old12 closed longpair roots vs new12 normal roots; same environment,color,full action,window length,count,frequency and weight.
multi_step.first_step: Compute chain first predicted latent from that chain true initial latent. No extra first-step chain loss; this permits identical independent single-step samples in the two arms.
multi_step.loss: Existing .25*(mean equal4group changed-weighted decoded feature error+.25 latent MSE) at steps2 and3, exact same formula; no new loss/weight.

single_step_loss: Existing mean equal4group changed-weighted decoded feature error+.25 actual successor latent MSE.
optimizer: same AdamW lr1e-4 wd1e-4 clip5; fresh optimizer in each arm; only transition parameters.
selection: Unchanged minimum .5oldC37-root mean single-step feature error+.5newC-selection6-root same error; earlier tie. No C-validation or D3/D4 reads.

validation.roots: Existing6 C dev_validate roots excluded from this training and checkpoint selection. Historically seen in previous studies: report as held-out development backtest, not fresh independent test.

gate_frozen_before_training.C_selection: Both seeds: selected new-chain score strictly less than old-chain score.
gate_frozen_before_training.C_backtest_primary: Both seeds: normal recursive step3 all9 count >= both initial and old-chain count+1; sum recursive step3+step4 >= both reference sums+2.
gate_frozen_before_training.retention: Both seeds: normal recursive step1 and step2 and one-step step3 and step4 cannot each lose more than1/6 root vs either reference. Actual-state query predictions must be identical across transition arms.
gate_frozen_before_training.if_pass: Freeze choices, then collect exactly12 new D5 roots (4/color),2branches,96calls maximum; same900control+96posthold,internal2/external0, no replacements.
gate_frozen_before_training.if_fail: No newD collection, no second tuning round. Report negative/inconclusive result and return for decision.
gate_frozen_before_training.interpretation: Operational finite-study gate; not statistical significance or replacement of original acceptance criteria.

evaluation: Same fixed root cohorts, full9, Holding/In/drawer, paired actual-readout vs one-step vs recursive, per-proposition and physical place truth. Normal primary; refusals separate. D3/D4 only seen diagnostics, not accessed by training/selection.
budget: 4runs x1000updates,256000single draws,48000three-skill chain draws; no other run or hyperparameter change.
